invariants.rationale: index is incremented at the start of the method; it is at least 1 unless method is called with index at Integer.MIN_VALUE.
After increment, if index == states.size-1, states.removeLast() is called, which reduces size by 1.
states.size cannot become negative via removeLast().
If index == states.size-1, size is decremented after removeLast(), otherwise index < size still holds.
